source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보 데이터에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create one independently randomized, complex photographic qualification scene using the attached image for facial appearance. The selected agent-owned direction is a synth-singer costume model beside a recording console in the quiet instant after the final fader adjustment: engineered sound equipment becomes a context for a personal, camera-acknowledging presence. WHO: an adult female costume model with reference-guided facial appearance and a contained smile; no claim about the reference person's actual identity, age, personality or history. WHERE: a contemporary sound recording control room. HOW: a directed, full-length portrait that first reads the face and then the linked costume layers. WHY NOW: fingertips remain at one fader while the shoulders have already turned toward the camera. Sensual=1 is a supporting quality carried by the calm gaze, lightly shaped bodice and warm edge light; fetish=0 and surreal=0 add no treatment. All costume, hair, color, pose, setting, age presentation and camera choices are agent-owned and editable on open dimensions. The six chosen appearance relationships will be considered for optional opt-in tests only after freeze and data integration.
subject: An adult female costume model; the requesting-user ownership is limited to reference-guided portrait subject, while adult presentation and costume styling are agent choices.
setting: A compact contemporary recording control room with an inclined console and a large booth window, chosen independently inside the coordinator-owned sound/music-space sampling scope.
event: The reference-guided portrait subject is captured in one still photograph. The final-fader gesture and shoulder turn are agent-owned staging, not requester-owned event semantics.
visual_priorities: The reference-guided face catches the first light as the model turns from the console to the camera.
Two long high hair tails emerge from roots bracketed by rigid open rectangular frames.
A headset boom curves from the left earpiece toward the corner of the mouth.
The collar and narrow tie connect to a sleeveless bodice while detached forearm sleeves remain visibly separate from its armholes.
A waist-mounted belt supports a pleated skirt whose translucent stepped hem is visibly layered.
Thigh-high stocking tops and the skirt hem retain a readable interval between their garment edges.
baseline_prompt_en: A layered photographic concept test featuring a reference-guided portrait subject, captured in one still photograph. An adult female costume model stands beside the inclined console in a contemporary recording control room. The supplied image guides her facial appearance, retaining the visible face contour, eye spacing, nose shape and softly shaped lips. Her black costume wig divides into two long high side tails; a rigid open rectangular hair frame brackets the root of each tail. A close-fitting headset has two earpieces and a short boom curving from her left earpiece toward the corner of her mouth. Her original charcoal, wine-red and pale-nickel synth-singer outfit connects a standing collar to a sleeveless tapered bodice with a narrow front tie. Separate ribbed forearm sleeves end below the upper arms, leaving a clear separation from the bodice armholes. A waist-mounted belt supports a short pleated skirt with a translucent stepped hem. Opaque thigh-high stockings stop below the skirt hem, leaving a visible interval between the two garment edges. These relationships form one continuous performance silhouette. Her left fingertips rest on a single fader; the console enters at the right edge of the frame beside her left hip. Both feet support her on the floor, weight mainly over the right leg, and her right arm hangs naturally beside the skirt. Her shoulders turn toward the camera after one final fader adjustment; her eyes meet the lens with a small, contained smile. Behind her, a booth window, dark acoustic fins and low glowing level meters make the recent listening session legible. Pale window light after rain crosses her face and reveals the costume's seams, while a low amber practical light edges the two hair tails. A vertical full-length portrait from chest height, with natural 50 mm perspective, gives her face first emphasis, then the headset and linked costume layers; the shallow console diagonal draws the eye back to her.
